notes: GEM tracker geocoded ~3km off into forested terrain. OSM has the plant as a `landuse=industrial` polygon at Kedungbunder; satellite confirms massive limestone quarry + cement plant.
GEM tracker geocoded into forest. Mapbox satellite at the override coords clearly shows large open-pit limestone quarry plus white industrial cement-plant buildings with conveyor systems.

GEM tracker geocoded offshore in the Java Sea. Mining paper (UTM 49S X=602720-602860 Y=9238080-9238200) gave Z-19 quarry block at (-6.892, 111.930); plant complex itself centered ~3km NW per satellite — kiln, silos, conveyors, warehouses all visible at the override coords. 15 Mt/yr — Indonesia's largest cement plant by capacity.

GEM tracker (or upstream Pupuk Indonesia) geocoded ~5km east of plant onto coastal water. Plant in Krueng Geukueh, Dewantara District, North Aceh. Mapbox satellite at override coords shows fertilizer plant complex (reactor towers, silos, port infrastructure) — consistent with PIM-1 (1985) + PIM-2 (2005) capacity 1.14 Mt/yr. NOTE: GoB v3 has only 8 detected buildings within 50km of Lhokseumawe — Aceh data coverage gap. Override is more accurate but does not recover the rooftop signal until RV7 (multi-source) lands.
GEM tracker geocoded 10 km south into Sidoarjo CBD residential (caught entire metro). OSM has the actual plant as `landuse=industrial` polygon at Kedungturi, Taman; centroid is the polygon centroid.
GEM tracker geocoded 10 km south. OSM has the Freeport-McMoRan smelter as `landuse=industrial` polygon in Gresik; override is the polygon centroid.
GEM tracker geocoded 3 km east. OSM has the Cilegon Krakatau Posco Power Plant as `landuse=industrial` polygon; override is the polygon centroid.

GEM tracker geocoded ~32 km NW into pure jungle. cemnet.com places plant at Desa Selangkau, Kaliorang, Kutai Timur. Mapbox geocoded Selangkau village at (0.7797, 117.7837); zoom-14 scan revealed coastal industrial complex with long jetty SW of village; zoom-16 confirmed cement plant infrastructure (storage halls, jetty, conveyor) at (0.765, 117.760). 4 Mt/yr post-2023 build — both GoB v3 (May 2023) and MS GMLBF imagery predate plant commissioning, so rooftop_MWp remains 0. Override fixes PVOUT, substation proximity, captive power matching for the correct location and unblocks rooftop on next imagery refresh.

CGSP IIA centroid was 13 km NE in upstream nickel mining area; ANTAM Feronikel smelter complex (port + multiple jetties + organized industrial) is the actual processing facility. OSM polygon way/299975398 'Pabrik Feronikel Unit Bisnis ANTAM' (77.3 ha) at the override coords. CGSP cluster also includes other Processing children at IPIP — this polygon covers the ANTAM PEFTA core; broader IPIP cluster boundary may need a relation or manual KML.

Harita Group / Halmahera Persada Lygend HPAL complex on Obi Island. Untagged in OSM Nominatim but visible as way/1282881067 (10.2 ha core) via Overpass + zoom-13 visual scan revealed massive smelter complex with port + tailings ponds 4 km E of CGSP cluster centroid. Override + polygon get the buffered building catchment onto the actual plant. Note: 10.2 ha is the visible OSM-tagged core; full Harita complex extends further so rooftop will undercount until a fuller polygon trace lands.

CGSP IIA centroid was 8 km S in farmland/forest. OSM relation 14284935 is the Konawe industrial multipolygon (349 ha, landuse=industrial multipolygon) covering Delong Nickel Phase II + adjacent smelter facilities at the coast. Zoom-16 satellite confirms massive industrial complex with smelter buildings, conveyor systems, and tailings ponds. Override moves to relation centroid.

CGSP IIA centroid was 5 km E in forest. IWIP has no comprehensive OSM relation; built a union of 7 named industrial sub-facility ways (PLTU Weda Bay coal plant 84.7 ha, plus 镍铁KJH nickel-iron and 电厂 1-4/5-8/9-11 power plants) totaling 116.6 ha. Mapbox imagery may pre-date some IWIP buildings (commissioned 2018-2024); rooftop signal will improve as multi-source preprocessor catches up.

CGSP IIA centroid was 1 km W of polygon (just outside fence). OSM way/592275190 'Huadi Nickel-Alloy Indonesia' (121.8 ha, landuse=industrial) is the BIP main smelter operated by Huadi Group. Override moves to polygon centroid.

GEM tracker geocoded 546m S of actual plant. Largest GoB-detected building (34,733 m²) sits at -6.17862, 106.92044 — clearly the central production hall of the Master Steel mill. Override + new polygon move both centroid and fence into alignment with the actual factory.
